name: AGS02MA TVOC gas sensor
description: Aosong/ASAIR MEMS metal-oxide gas sensor with a built-in ASIC that reports total volatile organic compounds (TVOC, 0-99999 ppb, calibrated with ethanol, ±25 % of reading) over a slow I2C bus (30 kHz max). Runs on 3.3-5.5 V, about 28 mA for the heater; needs 120 s preheat and a 2 s sampling period. Sold as: Adafruit AGS02MA I2C TVOC Gas Sensor (PID 5593), the bare 4-lead sensor (VDD, SDA, GND, SCL, 2.5 mm pitch) with no pull-ups, I2C address 0x1A.
eli5: Smells the air for fumes like alcohol, paint, cooking or smoke and tells your board how much is around.

pins.name: VDD
pins.description: Supply, 3.3-5.5 V (use 3.3 V so the SDA/SCL pull-ups stay at 3.3 V logic)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data; no pull-up on the sensor, add 10 kΩ to VDD

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (30 kHz max); no pull-up on the sensor, add 10 kΩ to VDD

buildNotes: Run the I2C bus at 20 kHz (I2C(..., freq=20000)); the AGS02MA does not work at 100 or 400 kHz. Boards that cannot go that slow (e.g. SAMD21/SAMD51) cannot talk to it.
SDA and SCL need 1-10 kΩ pull-ups to VDD; the bare sensor has none. Power it from 3.3 V so the pulled-up lines stay at 3.3 V logic.
Read TVOC: write register 0x00, wait 30 ms, read 5 bytes: status, TVOC (24-bit, ppb, MSB first), CRC-8 (poly 0x31, init 0xFF over the first 4 bytes).
Status bit 0 (RDY) = 1 means not ready / still preheating (at least 120 s after power-up). Do not read more often than every 1.5 s or RDY stays 1; a 2 s period is recommended.
The 4 leads are on a 2.5 mm pitch; they fit a 2.54 mm breadboard row or socket.
Fresh sensors need long burn-in (12 h after up to a week of storage, 72-96 h after longer storage) before readings settle.

driver.code:
# AGS02MA TVOC gas sensor (Aosong/ASAIR AGS02MA, datasheet June 2022), MicroPython driver.
# I2C address 0x1A. The bus MUST run at 30 kHz or slower (use freq=20000), and SDA/SCL need
# 1-10 kOhm pull-ups to VDD. Every reply is 4 data bytes + CRC-8 (poly 0x31, init 0xFF).
# Preheat at least 120 s after power-up; read TVOC no more often than every 1.5 s (2 s period).
import time

_REG_TVOC = 0x00
_REG_CAL = 0x01
_REG_VERSION = 0x11
_REG_RESISTANCE = 0x20
_REG_ADDR = 0x21


def _crc8(data):
    crc = 0xFF
    for b in data:
        crc ^= b
        for _ in range(8):
            crc = ((crc << 1) ^ 0x31) & 0xFF if crc & 0x80 else (crc << 1) & 0xFF
    return crc


class AGS02MA:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x1A):
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        self.ready = False

    def _read(self, reg):
        # Write the register, wait 30 ms (datasheet note 1), then read Data1..Data4 + CRC.
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, bytes([reg]))
        time.sleep_ms(30)
        d = self.i2c.readfrom(self.addr, 5)
        if _crc8(d[0:4]) != d[4]:
            raise OSError('AGS02MA CRC mismatch: check wiring, pull-ups and I2C speed (<= 30 kHz)')
        return d

    def _write(self, reg, data4):
        buf = bytes([reg]) + bytes(data4) + bytes([_crc8(data4)])
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, buf)
        time.sleep_ms(30)

    def tvoc(self):
        """TVOC in ppb (24-bit, 0-99999). Sets self.ready from the status RDY bit (0 = ready);
        returns None while the sensor is still preheating / data not ready."""
        d = self._read(_REG_TVOC)
        self.ready = (d[0] & 0x01) == 0
        if not self.ready:
            return None
        return (d[1] << 16) | (d[2] << 8) | d[3]

    def resistance_kohm(self):
        """Sensing-element resistance in kOhm (32-bit raw, unit 0.1 kOhm)."""
        d = self._read(_REG_RESISTANCE)
        return ((d[0] << 24) | (d[1] << 16) | (d[2] << 8) | d[3]) / 10

    def version(self):
        """Firmware version (Data4 of register 0x11)."""
        return self._read(_REG_VERSION)[3]

    def zero_calibrate(self):
        """Zero-point calibration in fresh air after >= 5 min powered. Lost at power-off."""
        self._write(_REG_CAL, (0x00, 0x0C, 0xFF, 0xF3))

    def set_address(self, new_addr):
        """Change the I2C address (1-127). Saved permanently, takes effect at once."""
        new_addr &= 0x7F
        inv = (~new_addr) & 0xFF
        self._write(_REG_ADDR, (new_addr, inv, new_addr, inv))
        self.addr = new_addr

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from ags02ma import AGS02MA

# The AGS02MA only works on a slow bus: 20 kHz.
i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}), freq=20000)
sensor = AGS02MA(i2c)
while True:
    ppb = sensor.tvoc()
    if ppb is None:
        print('warming up')
    else:
        print('TVOC=%dppb' % ppb)
    time.sleep(2)  # sampling period >= 2 s
